# Natron 2.6 (Niik-l's fork), with a Nuke layer

This repository is a copy of [Niik-l's Natron 2.6](https://github.com/Niik-l/Natron) (Natron with a 3D workspace,
Python 3.14 and Qt 6) with a **layer** added on the `sng/main` branch that makes Natron look and behave like Nuke by
default: Nuke's look, Nuke's keys, Nuke's node names in Tab search, importing an artist's own Nuke preferences, a
pack of everyday gizmos, workflow scripts, ToolSets and an expression menu. No file of Niik-l's is changed.

- **What this fork adds, in plain words:** [`FORK.md`](../FORK.md)
- **Every change at once:** [compare `RB-2.6...sng/main`](https://github.com/BeeeFX/Natron/compare/RB-2.6...sng/main)
- **The layer itself:** [`layer/README.md`](../layer/README.md)
- **Niik-l's own introduction to his fork** (building it, its features, its releases): [`README.md`](../README.md)

`RB-2.6` is an exact copy of Niik-l's branch; `sng/main` is his code plus the layer. GitHub shows this page (a
`.github/README.md` comes before the root one) when `sng/main` is the branch the repository opens on.
